description: Transparent recall for any MCP-capable harness. Use this at task start or before answering to show exactly which memories were used.

ids.description: Exact memory IDs from a prior Pathmark context block. Preserves the original visible-recall set.

includeRecords.description: Include a second, untruncated full-record copy alongside usedMemories. Defaults to false: it duplicates data already in context/usedMemories and is unbounded in size. Set true only when full record bodies are required.

query.description: Task, repo, or question to retrieve memory for. Empty query returns recent records.

tags.description: Optional tags to scope visible recall, such as the current workspace tag.

name: recall_memory
title: Recall memory
